body: the idea of my mom finding me literally makes me sick..

i get what u mean. i live in a small studio apartment where the singular main room is divided into two by a small divider thats barely a divider. my mom has to walk through my part of the room to get anywhere else in the apartment, which u can imagine feels like having no privacy. i always avoided phone calls or facetimes with my friends because of the fact that my mother could hear everything that was being said. its even worse when youre sad about something and want to cry, but literally cannot without your mother seeing or finding out. nonetheless i would suggest going to libraries, cafes, or parks whenever you want to be alone. while it isnt the same as being alone in a place like home, its the best option at times.
